program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            seen.add((r, c))
            stack = [(r, c)]
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if (0 <= yy < height and 0 <= xx < width and
                            (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = [[grid[y][x] for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
                     for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
            objects.append((c0, shape))

    objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    output = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
    row_offset = col_offset = 0
    for _, shape in objects:
        for y, row in enumerate(shape):
            for x, value in enumerate(row):
                if value and row_offset + y < height and col_offset + x < width:
                    output[row_offset + y][col_offset + x] = value
        row_offset += len(shape) - 1
        col_offset += len(shape[0]) - 1
    return output
'''
